_comment: Single source of truth for per-page SEO metadata. Edit this file, then run `node seo-tools/build-seo.js` (from the repo root) to regenerate the <head> block, the visually-hidden <h1>, sitemap.xml and robots.txt into cb-app.public. `node seo-tools/check-seo.js` validates it and fails CI on problems. Set "inSitemap": false on a page to keep it out of sitemap.xml while it is still being finished; add paths to site.disallow to add Disallow: lines to robots.txt.
